newsitem.title: USA: Northwest July passenger load factor off.
newsitem.headline: Northwest July passenger load factor off.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said its systemwide passenger load factor for July fell to 77.6 percent from 78.0 percent a year ago.
The airline said it flew 6.84 billion revenue passenger miles in July, up 3.0 percent over the previous year's results of 6.64 billion RPMs.
Available seat miles increased 3.5 percent in July to 8.81 billion ASMs from 8.52 billion ASMs in July 1996.
Cargo ton miles systemwide were down 0.3 percent in July 1997 as Northwest flew 193.3 million CTM, a decrease of 0.5 million CTM from 1996, the airline said.
